item.title: Russian forces lose key battlefield advantage after Starlink terminals abruptly shut down
item.description: Starlink terminals used by Russian forces have been shut down, causing severe communications problems and halting assault operations on the battlefield.

item.title: Super Bowl ads see Bradley Cooper, Matthew McConaughey going head-to-head while Lady Gaga sings her heart out
item.description: Super Bowl commercials 2025 feature Bradley Cooper, Matthew McConaughey, Ben Affleck and Lady Gaga in star-studded celebrity-packed ads for major brands.

item.title: Super Bowl tickets hit as high as $30,000 ahead of the Patriots-Seahawks showdown
item.description: Super Bowl LX ticket prices hit shocking heights with the cheapest seats at $3,590 and the most expensive tickets hitting $30,112 at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara.

item.title: Puka Nacua keeps Super Bowl presence alive in Toyota’s game day commercial
item.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua won’t play in the Super Bowl but will still appear during the big game in a new Toyota commercial.

item.title: Hims & Hers responds to FDA pressure, pulls knockoff Wegovy drug launch after regulatory threats
item.description: Telehealth company Hims & Hers cancels $49 monthly weight-loss drug launch following FDA warnings about unapproved semaglutide compounds and Novo threats.

item.title: BMW recalls nearly 90,000 vehicles over engine starter fire risk
item.description: BMW North America is recalling nearly 90,000 vehicles in the U.S. due to an engine starter defect that could overheat and pose a fire risk, according to federal safety regulators.

item.title: Wisconsin demands $1M from Burger King franchisee over 1,600 alleged child labor, wage violations
item.description: Wisconsin officials say a Burger King franchise operator committed more than 1,600 child labor and wage violations and faces over $1 million in payments.

item.title: Super Bowl LX players lose thousands to California's 'jock tax' on athlete income
item.description: Players competing in Super Bowl LX in Santa Clara will face California's jock tax, which subjects players to taxes for days spent in the state preparing for or participating in games.

item.title: Costco drops fresh lineup of Valentine's treats and savory bites for shoppers: report
item.description: Costco’s latest food rollout reportedly includes new baked goods, desserts and ready-to-eat meals, with several items featuring Valentine’s Day flair.

item.title: Trump predicting 100K on Dow by time he leaves office, claims he was 'right about everything'
item.description: President Donald Trump predicted the Dow would hit 100,000 by the time he leaves office in 2029 after the market closed above 50,000 for first time.
